segments.contextAfter: Create a texture that shares storage with a buffer that uses private storage (see [`MTLStorageMode.private`](mtlstoragemode/private.md)) with the [`makeTexture(descriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:)`](mtlbuffer/maketexture(descriptor:offset:bytesperrow:).md) method. Call [`minimumLinearTextureAlignment(for:)`](mtldevice/minimumlineartexturealignment(for:).md) to determine the alignment requirements for the texture data; the alignment requirements are different in Simulator. When setting the texture’s [`usage`](mtltexturedescriptor/usage.md) property, you can’t include [`renderTarget`](mtltextureusage/rendertarget.md) as one of the uses.
